name: News Desk (wizard template) — front-end for the YakYak engine

parameters.content:
## 📄 YakYak Description — workflow summary (not a step note)
News Desk archetype (wizard-created). Reads the configured sources (URLs and/or X handles) and asks the YakYak AI story-research endpoint to write today's episode — the API compiles the head-writer prompt and does its own web_fetch/web_search, so this workflow holds no Anthropic key and does no scraping itself.

nodes.name: On schedule
nodes.notes: Cron + timezone set by the wizard at instantiation time (WS5 create-show). Use 'Test workflow' to fire a run by hand.

nodes.name: Show config
nodes.notes: ALL per-show config lives here, on the canvas — filled in by the wizard (create-show, WS5) at instantiation time via the {{YY_*}} substitution mechanism (n8n-workflow-import.service.ts). sources is the array of {kind:'url'|'x_handle', value, lookbackDays?} objects from the wizard's Sources step. postToSocial defaults false (review-first, WS9).

nodes.name: Write story (YakYak AI)
nodes.notes: Same 'YakYak API' Bearer credential as the engine — no Anthropic key on the canvas or in env. The API compiles the News Desk head-writer prompt server-side (show-archetypes.ts) from campaignId's showBible + these sources, and does its own web_fetch/web_search — this workflow never fetches the news sources itself. Timeout 600s (10min) for the research run.

nodes.name: Build story payload
nodes.notes: Thin passthrough — see Write story (YakYak AI)'s notes for where the real conversion happens now.

nodes.name: Call engine

workflowId.cachedResultName: YakYak engine — resolve target, patch or new episode, render, post

nodes.notes: Fires the generic YakYak engine in episode mode. Timeout 45 min — the engine only responds once the episode is generated AND rendered. Retry is safe: a re-run lands on the same unrendered slot.

nodes.name: Set social fields

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ Object.assign({ movieId: $json.movieId }, $('Build story payload').first().json.socialTitle ? { socialTitle: $('Build story payload').first().json.socialTitle } : {}, $('Build story payload').first().json.socialCaption ? { socialDescription: $('Build story payload').first().json.socialCaption } : {}) }}

nodes.notes: Showrunner parity: ≤50-char social title (from the story call) + headline-derived caption. onError=continue — cosmetic metadata must not kill a rendered episode.

nodes.name: Fetch campaign links
nodes.notes: The campaign's linked social networks — GET /social/campaign-links. Read-only, so it runs regardless; the postToSocial gate is applied in Build post list. onError=continue so Build post list can report a clear error.

nodes.name: Build post list
nodes.notes: One item per linked network. Linking networks to the campaign is a one-time manual step (yakyak.ai profile, or course/08-social-post) — with none linked, this emits zero items and the run still succeeds.

nodes.name: Post to socials
nodes.notes: POST /social/post-movie/{movieId}/{connectedNetworkId}, empty body — runs once per item, i.e. once per linked network. IRREVERSIBLE. onError=continue mirrors the showrunner: a per-network 4xx (mis-configured account etc.) must not fail the other networks or the run. Needs the social_publishing scope on the PAT.
